about_short_description.short_description: Relate provides the Collaborative Sales Management and CRM Software for the startups.

product.name: Relate CRM
product.description: A cloud-based CRM platform designed for B2B SaaS startups to manage customer data, track sales deals, and collaborate across teams in one unified system.

product.name: Relate Prospecting
product.description: A feature within Relate CRM that helps users track and manage potential leads from a single list, leveraging product and marketing data for lead qualification.

product.name: Relate Sales Cycles
product.description: A feature that structures and progresses sales activities through defined cycles to maintain team engagement and forward momentum in the sales pipeline.

product.name: Relate Email Management
product.description: An integrated email tool within Relate CRM that allows users to send, schedule, and track emails, including templates and performance statistics.

product.name: Relate Data Integration and API
product.description: APIs and data integration services that allow automatic syncing of internal product usage and marketing data into Relate CRM for unified customer insights.
